issues: 线框和实体都是满屏小字的通用 dashboard，实体化后画面里没有一个要读的字和主角
开场 20f 只有空白浅灰底，描线阶段大半屏长时间空着
浅灰纸 + 灰线 + 白卡，蓝图读作打印预览；橙色扫描线在浅底上发脏
线框按手排坐标近似对位，文字只是一条条占位线，扫过时细节对不上实体
changes: look 换成 graphite（近单色暗场 · 香槟金唯一强调），主体是一扇 1600×880 的虚构「Tessera」营收页窗口：128px 主数字 $4.82M、60px 页标题、三枚 52px KPI、占满下半区的金色面积图
线框与实体同源：方块、文字、图表共用一张几何表；方块描线（pathLength + dashoffset），文字是同位置的空心描边字、像笔一样从左往右写出，扫描时零跳位
蓝图语言：铅笔灰细线 + 24px 点阵 + 窗口四角裁切标记（第 1 帧就有）+ 香槟金尺寸标注 1600 / 880 / 56，标注在扫描线经过时熄灭
扫描：3px 白芯 + 香槟金辉光竖线，身后 300px 窗口内渐隐暖光，前沿正前方的线框先被预照明；84–92f 留一拍喘息再扫
时间表：分组错峰描线 8–80f（外框 → 侧栏逐项 → 页头 → 主数字/KPI → 图表）→ 92–124f 扫描 → 静止；全程 1.000→1.03 极缓推进
issuesEn: Both the wireframe and the solid UI were generic dashboards full of tiny text, so after materialising there was no hero and nothing to read
The first 20f were an empty light-grey background, and much of the frame stayed blank for a long time during the draw-on
Light grey paper, grey lines and white cards made the blueprint read as a print preview, and the orange scan line looked dirty on the light background
The wireframe was hand-positioned to approximate the layout and text was just placeholder bars, so details didn't line up with the solid UI as the scan passed
changesEn: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark, champagne gold as the only accent); the subject is a 1600×880 window of a fictional "Tessera" revenue page: a 128px $4.82M hero, a 60px page title, three 52px KPIs and a gold area chart filling the lower half

Wireframe and solid layers share one geometry table for boxes, text and chart; boxes are drawn with pathLength + dashoffset, and text is outlined type at the same position, written left to right like a pen, so nothing jumps when the scan passes

Blueprint language: pencil-grey hairlines, a 24px dot grid, crop marks at the window corners (present from frame one) and champagne dimension callouts 1600 / 880 / 56 that switch off as the scan line passes
Scan: a 3px white core with champagne glow, a 300px fading warm afterglow inside the window, and a pre-light on the wireframe just ahead of the front; an 8f breath (84–92f) before the scan starts
Timeline: grouped, staggered draw-on 8–80f (frame → sidebar items → header → hero/KPIs → chart), scan 92–124f, then stillness; a very slow 1.000→1.03 push throughout
